scope: Descriptive local PS1 condition/noise proxies. Catalogue PSF flux errors are not independently calibrated aperture noise or stellar completeness; source-selected distributions and percentile spreads are not independent-sky uncertainty. Compare all three bands; the bright-i point-proxy i22–23 stratum is empty by construction, not absent exposure. COSMOS local gr error proxies differ from the three physical backgrounds, while i is closer. Do not transfer a universal response, make a scalar depth-offset correction, infer system Pdet or claim the entire COSMOS control has these local conditions.
